Fields.Name: Start Bone
Fields.Description: The first bone of the chain.

Fields.Name: End Bone
Fields.Description: The last bone of the chain.

Fields.Name: Target Rotation Rate
Fields.Description: How much of the turn towards the target this chain takes (0 to 1).

Fields.Name: New Target Gain
Fields.Description: How fast the chain follows a new target (0 to 1 per frame).

Fields.Name: On Gain
Fields.Description: How fast the look-at blends in (0 to 1 per frame).

Fields.Name: Off Gain
Fields.Description: How fast the look-at blends out (0 to 1 per frame).
